Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/gpac && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/isomedia/isom_intern.c","function":"gf_isom_open_file","line":793,"var":"mov->store_traf_map","code":"if (OpenMode==GF_ISOM_OPEN_READ_DUMP) mov->store_traf_map = GF_TRUE;","note":"Opening in READ_DUMP enables fragment boundary tracking so later parsing records traf_map entries."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/isomedia/isom_read.c","function":"gf_isom_get_sample_count","line":1668,"var":"trak->Media->information->sampleTable->SampleSize->sampleCount","code":"return trak->Media->information->sampleTable->SampleSize->sampleCount + trak->sample_count_at_seg_start;","note":"The sample count used by later logic includes the per-segment offset accumulated during fragment parsing."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/isomedia/isom_read.c","function":"gf_isom_sample_is_fragment_start","line":5220,"var":"tmap->frag_starts[i].moof_template","code":"if (!trak->Media->information->sampleTable->traf_map) return GF_FALSE;","note":"The API consults the traf_map built from attacker-controlled fragment data when READ_DUMP is enabled."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/isomedia/isom_read.c","function":"gf_isom_sample_is_fragment_start","line":5230,"var":"finfo->sample_num","code":"if (finfo->sample_num == sampleNum) { ... frag_info->moof_template = finfo->moof_template; ... }","note":"A matching fragment entry copies the stored moof_template pointer into caller-visible output without duplicating it."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/isomedia/box_code_base.c","function":"stbl_box_del","line":4900,"var":"ptr->traf_map->frag_starts[i].moof_template","code":"for (i=0; i<ptr->traf_map->nb_entries; i++) { if (ptr->traf_map->frag_starts[i].moof_template) gf_free(ptr->traf_map->frag_starts[i].moof_template); }","note":"During teardown the same moof_template buffers are freed as part of destroying the sample table."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/isomedia/isom_read.c","function":"gf_isom_close","line":620,"var":"movie","code":"gf_isom_close(movie) eventually destroys the movie and its sample tables","note":"The close path releases the traf_map-owned template buffers, leaving any previously returned pointer dangling."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/isomedia/isom_read.c","function":"gf_isom_sample_is_fragment_start","line":5230,"var":"frag_info->moof_template","code":"frag_info->moof_template = finfo->moof_template;","note":"A subsequent read of the returned fragment info can dereference the freed template pointer, causing the heap-use-after-free read."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
PY
cat candidate_trace.json
printf '\n--- submit? ---\n' && ls -l ../.. && true` executed with exit code 0.
